protocol: Parental Process Pincer Pinky Promise Protocol.md
family_facing_reading: Start with the exact enforcement action: who acted, what was done, and under what written authority.
ARTICLE_II means identify the specific presidential or executive duty/power being claimed; the label alone does not decide legality.
STATUTE_TEXT means read the actual Act of Congress the Executive Branch says it is enforcing rather than relying on a speech, summary, headline, or game roll.
APPROPRIATIONS means check whether implementation depends on money Congress enacted, limited, conditioned, or did not provide.
REPAIR means correct any broken link in the chain: action to authority, authority to statute, statute to funding, or claim to receipt.
HOLD until one specific enforcement action is bound to the actual statute and appropriations path.

family_posture.message: Show the action. Show Article II. Show the statute. Show the money. Repair the broken link.

next_input: A specific enforcement action, agency action, directive, case, or claim for replay.
